projects.title: Aurora Marketplace
projects.description: Pan-European shopping marketplace app with personalised discovery and an offline AI shopping assistant.
projects.longDescription: Architected the Flutter platform behind the marketplace: a modular monorepo, a shared design system, remote-config driven home experiences and an on-device assistant powered by a small language model.
features: Personalised home with remote-config driven layouts
Shared design system with golden tests
Deferred components to keep the install size small
achievements: Scaled to five countries with one codebase

projects.title: PulseFit
projects.description: Fitness companion with adaptive training plans and live heart-rate tracking.
projects.longDescription: Built the cross-platform fitness app with wearable sync, offline workouts and beautiful animated charts, delivering weekly releases through automated pipelines.
achievements: Reached 1M installs in the first year
Weekly releases for two years with no rollbacks

projects.title: MoveIt
projects.description: Urban mobility app combining e-scooters, bikes and public transport in one journey planner.
projects.longDescription: Delivered live maps, route planning and in-app payments, with a modular architecture that allowed three squads to work in parallel.
achievements: Enabled three squads to ship in parallel
Real-time map held 60 fps on mid-range devices

projects.title: Lumen Sleep
projects.description: Sleep and mindfulness app with smart alarms and soothing soundscapes.
projects.longDescription: Built the Android client and later the Flutter rewrite, featuring background audio, sleep analysis and a fully accessible interface.
achievements: Featured by Google Play in the Wellbeing collection

projects.title: Aurora Assistant
projects.description: On-device AI shopping assistant that answers product and order questions offline.
projects.longDescription: Prototyped, then productionised a small-language-model assistant that runs fully on device. Includes retrieval over product data, guarded answers that admit when data is missing, and a feature-flagged rollout to 5% then 100% of users.
features: Privacy-first: no prompts leave the device
achievements: Used by 1M+ people within six months
Reduced support tickets about order status by 22%

projects.title: Aurora Checkout
projects.description: Redesigned one-page checkout with saved payment methods and wallet support.
projects.longDescription: Led the redesign of the checkout flow with product and design, introducing wallet payments, address autocomplete and an experiment framework that allowed safe A/B testing.
achievements: Ran 14 A/B experiments in the first year

projects.title: Aurora Design System
projects.description: Open-source Flutter design system shared by all Aurora apps.
projects.longDescription: Created and maintain the design system: tokens, themes for light and dark mode, accessible components, golden tests per theme and a Storybook catalogue published to the web.
achievements: WCAG AA contrast on every component

projects.title: Orbit Pay
projects.description: Fintech MVP for peer-to-peer payments and shared expenses.
projects.longDescription: Built the full Flutter MVP in ten weeks for a seed-stage startup, including onboarding with identity verification, instant transfers, shared expense groups and a security-hardened architecture that passed a regulatory audit.
achievements: Passed a regulatory security audit first time

projects.title: TidyHome
projects.description: Smart-home controller app for lights, heating and energy monitoring.
projects.longDescription: Ongoing engagement building a Flutter app for a smart-home startup: device discovery over local network, scenes and schedules, energy dashboards and over-the-air firmware update flows.
achievements: Handover documentation reduced client onboarding to 2 days
Zero critical bugs in the last 3 releases

projects.title: Lumen Wear
projects.description: Wear OS companion that tracks sleep stages from the wrist.

Used by 20% of Lumen Sleep users
